display_name: 固定 SIG_TIME：时序自挑战原样扩展 02/03（条件准备）
description: Conditional unchanged continuation of the first fixed-seed pilot:6scratch50 models at predefined02/03,3arms each,2historical oldgate+cos rows reused. No new scientific hypothesis, no first-seed retraining; launch only after original source PASS and source decision committed/pushed before new model target numeric retrieval.
authorization: User active84% goal and latest instruction to fix SIG_TIME architecture and prioritize DG/SSL training mechanisms; default classifier jointly trained, oldgate+cos reference, <=50epochs/model. No target feedback or independent fitted classifier.

code.environment: Ordinary N607 existing CVS-RFFI, full FP32, CPU2threads/worker; no environment mutation

data.representation: Approved existing source IQ2x256; fixed SIG_TIME post-dropout t2; L6300/U56700 TX hidden/V27000 health-only; same split392005/physical roles/NoExplicitCFO. Masking only L intermediate feature during training; no query/target training.

roles.U_s: 56700 true TX hidden; unchanged original oldgate+EMA; unmasked U and teacher forwards

data.capsule_id: existing VALIDATED_ONCE Phase1 clean capsule, unchanged physical IDs

permissions.claim_scope: Phase1 default-head clean on declared physical split only; self-challenge source signal does not prove DG or Phase2/newTX/satellite performance

checkpoint.initialization: All6 newmodels scratch with corresponding fixed nominal seed02/03; no model/EMA/checkpoint inheritance. Historical rows reused for evaluation only. First fixed SIG_TIME final50 used solely by real-checkpoint no-query preflight, never training initialization.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: SOURCE scratch EXACT_MATCH checked by existing source pipeline; preflight frozen source checkpoint read-only smoke only and nottraining initialization
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final50/11100 each row; no V/target checkpoint selection

execution.gpu_policy: shared capacity lock; all owners max3 processes/GPU and >=12000MiB free; no stop/restart/hot-edit of existing runs
execution.stop_rule: Only run-owned systemic technical failures: current data/default-head/hidden-U mismatch, nonfinite loss/gradients, unidentifiable fixed mask, failed RNG replay, missing updates, repeated launch failure or immutable-output collision. Preserve partial outputs; no automatic retry, unrelated stop/restart or target-feedback changes. Scientific source-rule FAIL prevents expansion but all fixed first-seed rows still finish/scored. Conditional launch additionally requires the original first-source PASS; source decision committed/pushed before new numeric target retrieval. No new source/target selection after extension.

metric_names: Default-head clean TX accuracy/macroF1/worstRX/worstday and paired differences; fixed n1 cannot complete goal
All11100 L original/selected CE, masking counts, native-consumed CE and22200extra forwards per model
Actual t1/t2/SIG/W original/selected/delta gradients:52batches/208layers/624vectors; saved masks independently recounted
Unmasked L CE source health and actual deployment feature changes; source-only unchanged-seed expansion rule

fixed_rules.expansion: If exact source budgets, default deployment feature, unmasked CE health and nonzero t1/t2/SIG delta gradients pass for BOTH variants, extend all three unchanged arms to02/03; freeze and push decision before reading new target numeric summaries. No target-based expansion/cancellation or masking retuning.

source_falsification.expansion: If exact source budgets, default deployment feature, unmasked CE health and nonzero t1/t2/SIG delta gradients pass for BOTH variants, extend all three unchanged arms to02/03; freeze and push decision before reading new target numeric summaries. No target-based expansion/cancellation or masking retuning.

temporal_rsc.gradient: sum true-class default-head logits w.r.t. actual t2; mean over96channels, signed
temporal_rsc.time_rule: keep score strictly below per-packet linear2/3quantile; reject unidentifiable mask
temporal_rsc.packet_rule: mask all packets once; select true-class probability drop >= batch linear2/3quantile
temporal_rsc.random_control: same current-model selected packets and per-packet zero count; private shuffle32
temporal_rsc.control: same original/spatial/final three-forward cost, final all-ones replay; return original CE graph
temporal_rsc.loss: replace native L CE with selected masked CE smoothing.01; no auxiliary coefficient or extra optimizer
temporal_rsc.replay: train mode; replay original CPU/currentCUDA dropout RNG; restore ambient RNG
temporal_rsc.forward_accounting: 11100 native L contexts +22200 additional L forwards; counters separate, no suppressed count
temporal_rsc.optimizer: original AdamW lr.0002 WD.0001 cosine, 33label+17pseudo, no reset
temporal_rsc.source_basis: Three fixed source models pass challenge-vs-random probe; not evidence of training or DG benefit
